popCulture.description: Lists Erythia (Erytheia) among the Hesperides who guard the golden apples with Ladon — the sunset 'Red One', not the island of Geryon that bears the same name.

popCulture.title: Hesperides
popCulture.description: One of Apollodorus' four apple-nymphs of the far west — Erytheia the Hesperid, distinct from Erytheia the island.
